note: Hand-maintained transfer and cap rules, applied by lib/fares.ts on top of the per-system tables in fares.json (which CI regenerates). Each rule names its source and how sure we are. Rules are date-gated (Asia/Bangkok) and `enabled: false` rules are recorded but never applied. Station ids are internal ids, not display codes (see AGENTS.md). Checked 2026-11-13.

rules.source: MRTA Purple Line fare regulation effective 2026-07-03: the entry fare is charged once when changing between MRTA lines at stations the MRTA board designates (https://www.nationthailand.com/news/40067698). No designated station is named; 14 baht is MRTA's entry fee. Checked against a rider: Bang Sue to Wong Sawang is 17 + 20 - 14 = 23.

rules.source: Eastern Bangkok Monorail terms (BL15 -> YL01 in the operator's numbering): exit Blue and enter Yellow within 30 minutes on the same EMV card for a 15 baht entry-fee discount, refunded within 3 days (7 working days by issuer). https://ebm.co.th/en/ticket-emv/ (read 2026-11-13). Only this direction is documented.

message.en: Includes a ฿{amount} transfer discount: tap out of Blue and into Yellow at Lat Phrao within 30 minutes with the same contactless (EMV) card; the entry fee is refunded to the card.
message.th: รวมส่วนลดการเปลี่ยนสาย ฿{amount}: แตะออกสายสีน้ำเงินและแตะเข้าสายสีเหลืองที่ลาดพร้าวภายใน 30 นาทีด้วยบัตร EMV ใบเดิม ค่าแรกเข้าจะคืนเข้าบัตร

rules.source: Northern Bangkok Monorail terms: exit Purple at Nonthaburi Civic Center (PP11) and enter Pink (PK01) within 30 minutes on the same EMV card for 15 baht off the Pink entry fee, refunded within 3 days (7 working days by issuer). https://nbm.co.th/en/ticket-emv/ (read 2026-11-13).

message.en: Includes a ฿{amount} transfer discount: tap out of Purple and into Pink at Nonthaburi Civic Center within 30 minutes with the same contactless (EMV) card; the entry fee is refunded to the card.
message.th: รวมส่วนลดการเปลี่ยนสาย ฿{amount}: แตะออกสายสีม่วงและแตะเข้าสายสีชมพูที่ศูนย์ราชการนนทบุรีภายใน 30 นาทีด้วยบัตร EMV ใบเดิม ค่าแรกเข้าจะคืนเข้าบัตร

rules.source: One BEM post seen only in a search snippet says 14 baht in this direction, and Infoquest (Jan 2024) says 13-14. Neither the Pink nor the Blue operator page documents it, so it is recorded but not applied. Enable only after reading the operator's own terms.

rules.source: MRTA and SRT 40 baht a day for Purple plus Red, EMV only, 1 Dec 2025 to 30 Nov 2026, refunded in 1-3 days (https://www.infoquest.co.th/?p=550437). Whether it is extended past 30 Nov 2026 is reported by one source only (Thairath, 2026-10-21), so it stops on that date until an operator notice says otherwise.

message.en: Includes ฿{amount} off: Purple and Red are capped at ฿40 a day with a contactless (EMV) card (to 30 Nov 2026); the rest is refunded to the card.

rules.source: Cabinet approved a 17-45 baht joint ticket for 2027 on 2026-11-03 (https://www.naewna.com/n/top-stories/146406/). The designated interchanges and the implementing regulation are not published, and it needs a Thai-national Paotang registration, so nothing is applied. Kept here so turning it on is a data edit once the rules exist.
